t: You're looking at the monument to Joanna Vassa in Abney Park Cemetery, in Hackney. Joanna was the only surviving adult child of Olaudah Equiano, the former slave and anti-slavery campaigner. That is why her grave matters here. It was given listed status in 2008, which means it is formally protected. Very little is known about her own life, so this stone is one of the few places where she is remembered. She lived from 1795 to 1857, and she was a congregationalist.
